claimText: Historical OIT page text: 'Copilot is currently the only generative AI tool made available by the Office of Information Technology (OIT).' The same legacy page was still online on 2026-10-20, but OIT's current Princeton-supported AI Tools directory lists several tools (including Copilot Chat, Adobe, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Claude and Zoom AI), so the 'only tool' statement is held as historical and not shown as current.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Copilot is currently the only generative AI tool made available by the Office of Information Technology (OIT). When you are logged in to Copilot with your Princeton University account, you are using Copilot with Enterprise Data Protection which better protects information.
